text.description_html:
Acorn IBLBP, Florence Robe Hook

This Florence Clothes Hook is a small, yet beautiful reminder of the old world. Perfect for almost any home, it is handy for keeping things off the floor in almost any room. Screw a few in by the front door for keys and lightweight bags or hang one in the kitchen for hand towels. The Florence Robe Hook comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Features and Specifications of the Florence Towel Hook:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Height: 4"
  • Projection: 3-1/4"

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 hook and mounting screws.
